INTRODUCING THE OFFICIAL NYNJ WORLD CUP CONCIERGE

Your guide to getting around, staying informed, and enjoying the NYNJ region.

HOME OF THE FIFA WORLD CUP 26™ FINAL
HOME OF THE FIFA WORLD CUP 26™ FINAL

And we are one. Welcome to New York New Jersey, where the beautiful game lives in our streets and our souls. From the City Skyline to the Jersey Shoreline, we are a soccer-impassioned metropolis, energized to host a FIFA World Cup™ unlike any other. With world-famous icons and hidden local gems, we are ready to share our culture, our neighborhoods, and our unbridled love for the game, on the global stage.
